title: ProofLayer Agent Security Scanner
description: Scan AI agent code, repositories, MCP server manifests, and agent configs for security issues before connecting them to coding agents.

target.title: Target
target.description: What kind of artifact should ProofLayer scan?

repoUrl.title: Repository URL
repoUrl.description: Git repository URL to clone when target is repository or mcpServer.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Optional branch, tag, or ref to clone.

mcpConfigUrl.title: MCP Config URL
mcpConfigUrl.description: URL returning an MCP server.json-style manifest or agent config JSON.

mcpConfigJson.title: MCP Config JSON
mcpConfigJson.description: Inline MCP manifest or AI client config JSON. Accepts either a JSON object or a JSON string.

sourceCode.title: Source Code
sourceCode.description: Inline source code to scan when target is code.

ruleSets.title: Rule Sets
ruleSets.description: Scanner coverage areas to include in the output metadata.

severityThreshold.title: Severity Threshold
severityThreshold.description: Only publish findings at or above this severity.

includeRemediation.title: Include Remediation
includeRemediation.description: Include remediation guidance in dataset rows and summary output.

repositoryScanMode.title: Repository Scan Mode
repositoryScanMode.description: Use quick for fast rule-based repository results. Use analyzer for deeper per-file analysis with a higher runtime cost.

maxRepositoryFiles.title: Max Repository Files
maxRepositoryFiles.description: Maximum number of source files to scan for repository targets. Lower values finish faster on large repositories; maximum is 500.

perFileTimeoutSeconds.title: Per-file Timeout Seconds
perFileTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to spend on any single repository file before recording a scan error and moving on.
